author: iiGucci
body:
Format:


Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?: In-game

Staff Member: Evocal

Guilty? (Yes or No): Yes

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: I think I should be unbanned because I have been banned for almost two years and me and my brother would always play on this server playing nebula I have never used hacks since I got banned from this server because this was one of my favorite servers and I don't want to get banned from any other servers that I like. I have also became much more mature because I am much older than I was when I got banned and I will be sure to not use hacks on this server ever again. Please consider me I really miss this server.

Any additional comments?: Happy Holidays!
